rowText: Decode-mode churn half: with the knowledge base on and a covered game running, sample the frame rate the way PRESET-STREAM-ANIM-01 did (8s of requestAnimationFrame timestamps) with decode mode on so both chips churn and then scroll: expect a flat 60fps with no gap over ~50ms.

setup.note: Speed-by-eye already PASSED 2026-09-17 (~27px/s); this row was owed the decode-mode timing sample.

steps.action: Sampled 480 requestAnimationFrame timestamps (about 8 seconds) on the panel while the preset chip carousel was on screen scrolling/churning in decode mode.

verdictSentence: The chip animation ran at a smooth, steady 60 frames a second for the full 8-second check, with no single frame taking longer than about 17 milliseconds -- no stutter or slow frame at all.
notes: This closes the decode-mode half; the reduced-motion half stays on the maintainer's page per plan section 8 question 7 (the rig does not touch Steam's own accessibility settings).
